## Compatibility

### Notes on Mainframe Interoperability

This app is compiled into a binary using a predefined GnuCOBOL compiler binary
on Windows made by [Arnold Trembley](https://www.arnoldtrembley.com/GnuCOBOL.htm),
on Linux via `gnucobol`, and on Docker systems.
Furthermore, I try stick to GnuCOBOL's basic syntax, and as such, this app is
not compatible for older mainframes, to the extent of my knowledge.
